title: AURIONS version 1 cognitive and operation domain payloads
description: Language-neutral payload schemas for cognitive and operational contracts. The common envelope and provider/interface-specific capability descriptor body are defined separately. Environment observation, discovery and capability descriptor records in this schema are device/provider-scoped integrations, not the universal representation of the world or of possible means. Context-independent objective, entity, relationship, situation, evidence, affordance, interaction and outcome contracts are defined in schemas/world-interaction.v1.schema.json. These schemas describe data shape, not authorization or proof of execution.

capabilityKnowledgeRevision.description: Evidence-backed revision about one device/provider/interface-specific descriptor in an explicit context. It must not be treated as universal competence or authority.

environmentObserved.description: Device/platform-specific observation record. The required device_id and platform_context fields are intentional for this integration family; use the context-independent world-interaction contracts for non-device entities, actors, resources and situations.

discoveryRequest.description: Request to a registered device/provider-specific discovery mechanism. This is not a universal requirement for discovering possible means; human-mediated and other non-provider means may be represented by the open-world interaction contracts.

discoveryResult.description: Result from a device/provider-specific discovery mechanism. It reports only the scope and evidence actually observed and does not define the complete set of possible means.

capabilityDescriptorRecord.description: Immutable device/provider/interface-specific descriptor record. This is one evidence source for an affordance hypothesis, not the universal ontology or action-space boundary.

command_type.description: Open namespaced command identifier; resolved by the receiver's versioned command registry, not a closed capability enum.

query_type.description: Open namespaced query identifier; resolved by the receiver's versioned query registry.

providerLifecycle.$comment: Provider trust lifecycle is independent of capability knowledge and never grants execution authority.

providerFailure.$comment: Typed provider/discovery failure. Dispatched or unknown side effects require reconciliation before retry.

revision.description: Optimistic concurrency revision; incremented exactly once for every committed task-run state transition.

taskRunTransition.description: Immutable task-run state transition. The event is appended in the same local transaction as the task_runs projection update. Runtime validation enforces revision = previous_revision + 1 and rejects no-op or illegal transitions.
